title: P2.15c Integrate bounded live shell recovery
description: Depends on production capabilities from task-709e2d7344084ec88f85e4362edd354a and task-9ecff2d91130481d8a112e071d4f4f0a. Objective: make the existing dirty Cordum shell projection and its retry affordance consume those bounded handshake/feed lifecycles as one source of truth. Deliverable: the composition root supplies one StrictMode-safe initial attempt plus a bounded retry factory, CordumApp alone owns live connection state and projects COMING ONLINE/CONNECTED/LAGGING/DISCONNECTED from current attempt/feed events, stale attempts cannot overwrite it, and refusal detail plus retry remain visible. Not in scope: changing daemon authority, inventing fixture success, editing feed/handshake internals, or reverting other Control Room WIP. Exact integration verification: `pnpm exec vitest run apps/control-room/src/live/live-handshake.test.ts apps/control-room/src/live/live-board.test.tsx apps/control-room/src/v2/cordum-app.test.tsx apps/control-room/src/v2/cordum-shell.test.tsx` with exit 0 and nonzero counts.
definitionOfDone: Verify-or-block before editing: at the delivered tree the focused tests for task-709e2d7344084ec88f85e4362edd354a and task-9ecff2d91130481d8a112e071d4f4f0a pass, and production grep confirms handshake request deadlines/caller abort plus feed active-request abort/LAGGING projection; report blocked if any premise is absent because relaxing the shell before them permits stale ONLINE or unbounded attachment.

The composition root prepares the one initial pairing promise before React replay and supplies a retry factory over the same already-scrubbed captured href; CordumApp allows at most one active attempt, resets to COMING ONLINE while retrying, and ignores all late results from superseded attempts.

One CordumApp-owned controlled connection value drives CordumShell: pending handshake/no first frame is COMING ONLINE, healthy SURFACE is CONNECTED, delivered REFUSED/UNREADABLE is LAGGING, transport loss/handshake refusal is DISCONNECTED, and later healthy feed data reconnects to CONNECTED without stale copies of initial props.

The refused live surface shows the exact existing local code and any validated daemon code/layer detail supplied by the prerequisite boundaries, exposes a visible Retry connection control only when retry is possible, disables duplicate concurrent retries, and never substitutes fixtures or treats an ambiguous timed-out pairing as success.

Integration tests cover StrictMode single initial redemption, success, bootstrap/pair timeout refusal, bounded retry, abort/late superseded response, feed loss, LAGGING, reconnect, and unmount cleanup; named state-source/retry-generation mutations red, the exact four-file command and `pnpm --filter @moe/control-room test` run with nonzero counts, and control-room typecheck exits 0.

(4) LATE SUPERSEDED RESPONSE — DIVERGENCE FIXTURE (epic rail 7A): the earlier attempt is a deferred that IGNORES its abort signal (never rejects on abort) so the abort relay cannot be the mechanism that drops it; sequence: `initial` refused → Retry → `retry` #1 deferred-ignoring-abort → (nothing resolves) → Retry is disabled, so instead make `retry` #1 resolve refused FIRST, then resolve the STALE `initial`-generation deferred with a VALID setup afterwards; assert the surface still shows the newer refusal and `/affordances` was NEVER fetched. (5) AMBIGUOUS PAIRING TIMEOUT: `initial` resolves AWAITING_OPERATOR whose `claim()` resolves `LIVE_PAIRING_REFUSED` after the deadline (use the resolver's own refusal value, not a hand-built success); assert refusal text and that `data-connection` never equals `CONNECTED`.
(6) UNMOUNT CLEANUP: the signal passed to `attempts.retry` is aborted on unmount, and a result resolved after unmount causes no state update (spy `console.error`, expect zero calls).
(7) FEED LOSS + RECONNECT: after CONNECTED, next `/affordances` fetch rejects → `DISCONNECTED`; next answers a valid SURFACE → `CONNECTED` again; assert the attribute went OFFLINE → CONNECTED → DISCONNECTED → CONNECTED in order via `waitFor` (no stale `initialConnection` seed).
Use fake timers only where the feed interval (2000 ms) must advance; prefer `vi.useFakeTimers({ shouldAdvanceTime: true })` per arm and restore in `afterEach`.

Pressing "I entered this label" before the terminal accepted it flips the button to "Checking approval..." and back, with no sentence, forever.
